ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in localized clusters and markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white markings including ring-shaped 'O' geometries and solid white clusters at the distal tips of both lobes. Significant white mottling is present along the bottom-most visible portion of the fluke base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a vertical depth of approximately 180 pixels from the highest lobe peak in this projection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; left lobe (viewer left) shows deep, jagged indentations and irregular peaks; right lobe shows a more continuous but still serrated edge with smaller pixel-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips; tips terminate in sharp, high-intensity upward-pointing vertices.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous fine, white/grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally and horizontally across the central black regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch or traumatic amputation of edge tissue on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique circular 'O' shaped white pigmentation patterns on the mid-to-lower sections of both lobes that provide a high-contrast alphanumeric-like appearance.
